name: std::basic_istream<CharT,Traits>::swap
intro: Calls basic_ios::swap(rhs) to swap all data members of the base class except for rdbuf(), and swaps the values of the gcount() counters between *this and rhs. This swap function is protected: it is called by the swap functions of the swappable input stream classes std::basic_ifstream and std::basic_istringstream, which know how to correctly swap the associated streambuffers.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
rhs

 -

 different basic_istream object of the same type to swap with
